About

Performance Creative,
Built From First Principles

DREXONYX is a performance creative studio. We exist to build UGC advertising that works — authentic, brand-safe, and optimized for the platforms where modern brands compete.

Why We Exist

The advertising landscape shifted. Audiences stopped responding to polished, produced brand content and started trusting peer recommendation, authentic experience, and human-scale storytelling. UGC advertising emerged to bridge that gap — and most brands are not yet equipped to produce it well or at the volume that modern paid media demands.

DREXONYX was built to solve that problem. We combine creative strategy, AI-assisted production, and rigorous QC into a studio built specifically for performance UGC advertising.

Values

What We Stand For

Performance Over Aesthetics

Beautiful creative that doesn't convert isn't doing its job. We judge every asset against performance criteria first.

Authentic, Not Manufactured

UGC advertising works because it feels real. We protect authenticity at every production stage.

Continuous Improvement

Every campaign generates data. We feed performance insights back into creative direction on every engagement.

Process

From Brief to Delivery

A structured, transparent production process designed for performance marketers who move fast.

01

Campaign Brief

Submit your campaign brief through our intake form. We collect your brand objectives, target audience, performance KPIs, and creative references.

02

Creative Strategy

Our creative strategists analyze your brief, review your competitive landscape, and develop a creative direction document with hook angles and concept sets.

03

Production

Our AI-assisted production pipeline turns approved concepts into campaign-ready assets against your brand guidelines and platform specifications.

04

Quality Control

Every deliverable goes through our multi-point QC process: brand guideline compliance, platform policy review, technical spec verification, and messaging accuracy.

05

Delivery

Approved assets are organized and delivered through your designated channel. Files are formatted, labeled, and platform-ready. Revisions within brief scope handled promptly.

Common Questions

Do you offer custom scopes outside standard packages?
Yes. If your campaign requirements don't fit a standard package, submit your brief and we'll scope a custom engagement.
How long does production take?
Turnaround varies by production type — from 48 hours for Spark packages to 15 business days for Cinematic Production. Timeline is confirmed at project start.
How are revisions handled?
Revisions within the original brief are included in each package. Out-of-scope changes are quoted separately.
Do you manage ad campaigns or media buying?
No. DREXONYX produces creative content and advertising assets. Campaign management, media buying, and ad optimization are outside our scope.
What information is needed to start?
Your brand guidelines, campaign objectives, target audience, platform targets, and any creative references. Email us and we'll guide you through the full brief.
